text:
You need an Android webview app with Firebase integration now, and potentially an Apple version if this first build goes well.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building React and JavaScript-based apps. I recently built an installable restaurant ordering web app for Saffron Lane Kitchens using React, Vite, Firebase, Stripe, and Workbox. It kept the menu and cart working on bad connections for 9 restaurants, and 22% of orders came through the app within 2 months.

For your project, I can build the Android webview app and connect Firebase cleanly so it’s ready for a future iOS version too. I work comfortably with React, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, and mobile-friendly UI.

Would you like the webview app to load a single website URL, or do you need native Firebase features like auth, push, or analytics built in too?
